$comment: Default evaluator weights for the CPU opponent (assembly/bot/eval.ts). Names/order come from
shared/botDataSchema.json. Penalties are negative. Edit, run `npm run bot:generate`, rebuild wasm.
The ranges are chosen so one hole (~ -6) outweighs a few rows of height, and a 4-line clear (+12)
outweighs a hole, which is what produces stack-clean / tetris-well play.
